title: 微软异步协作清单：让不在现场的人也能参与
topic: 微软异步协作清单：让不在现场的人也能参与

source.title: Asynchronous collaboration & accessibility checklist - Engineering Fundamentals Playbook

paragraphs: Purpose: Practical guidance for distributed teams to collaborate effectively and inclusively across time zones.
Post the above in a shared channel or issue and use threaded replies for follow-ups.
Record a short demo (5-8 minutes) focusing on the outcome and acceptance criteria.
Include a short transcript or key bullet points in the PR or release note.
Add captions or a brief written summary for accessibility.
Ensure headings and lists are semantically correct in markdown.
Provide captions/transcripts for videos and demos.
Ensure code samples are in accessible font sizes when shared in docs.
Rotate meeting times or facilitators to share burden across time zones.
Use asynchronous agendas: post an agenda in advance and capture decisions in writing.
Include a short PR description and steps to validate.
Mark urgent reviews clearly; otherwise assume a 24-48 hour review window for non-urgent PRs.
translations: 目的：为分布式团队提供实用指导，使其能够有效且包容地跨时区协作。
将上述内容发布在共享频道或问题中，并使用线程回复进行后续跟进。
录制简短演示（5-8分钟），重点关注成果和验收标准。
在拉取请求或发布说明中包含简短记录或关键要点。
添加字幕或简要书面摘要以提高可访问性。
确保在markdown中标题和列表的语义正确。
为视频和演示提供字幕/记录。
确保在文档中共享的代码样本使用可访问的字体大小。
轮换会议时间或主持人，以分担跨时区的负担。
使用异步议程：提前发布议程并以书面形式记录决策。
包含简短的拉取请求描述和验证步骤。
明确标记紧急审查；否则，非紧急拉取请求的审查窗口为24-48小时。
fullTextParagraphs: Purpose: Practical guidance for distributed teams to collaborate effectively and inclusively across time zones.

Include a short transcript or key bullet points in the PR or release note.
Add captions or a brief written summary for accessibility.
Provide alt text for images and diagrams.
Ensure headings and lists are semantically correct in markdown.
Provide captions/transcripts for videos and demos.

notes.phrase: Practical guidance for distributed teams to collaborate effectively and inclusively across time zones
notes.meaning: 为分布式团队提供实用指导，使其能够有效且包容地跨时区协作
notes.explain: 这个短语强调了为分散在不同地理位置的团队提供实际可行的协作方法，特别关注了跨时区工作时的包容性和有效性
notes.example: Our company provides practical guidance for distributed teams to collaborate effectively and inclusively across time zones through comprehensive onboarding materials.

notes.phrase: Record a short demo (5-8 minutes) focusing on the outcome and acceptance criteria
notes.meaning: 录制一个简短的演示（5-8分钟），重点关注结果和验收标准
notes.explain: 建议创建一个时间控制在5-8分钟内的演示视频，内容应突出展示最终成果和项目验收标准，便于远程团队成员理解
notes.example: Before submitting your feature request, record a short demo focusing on the outcome and acceptance criteria for the product team to review.

notes.phrase: Rotate meeting times or facilitators to share burden across time zones
notes.meaning: 轮换会议时间或主持人，以分担跨时区的负担
notes.explain: 这是一种促进跨时区团队公平参与的策略，通过定期调整会议时间或由不同地区的团队成员担任主持人，避免总是让特定时区的人员在不方便的时间参加会议
notes.example: To ensure fair participation, our agile team rotates meeting times or facilitators to share burden across time zones during our two-week sprint cycles.

notes.phrase: Use asynchronous agendas: post an agenda in advance and capture decisions in writing
notes.meaning: 使用异步议程：提前发布议程并以书面形式记录决策
notes.explain: 这是一种促进远程团队有效协作的方法，通过提前分享会议议程并在会后以书面形式记录决策，确保无法实时参会的人也能了解会议内容和结果
notes.example: Our global team uses asynchronous agendas: posting an agenda in advance and capturing decisions in writing to ensure all members can contribute regardless of their location.

scenario.title: Asynchronous Collaboration for Remote Team Members
english: Sarah, a marketing coordinator in New York, needs feedback on a campaign proposal from team members in London and Tokyo who are in different time zones.
The London team has conflicting priorities with another project deadline, while the Tokyo team needs more time to review due to language barriers.
Sarah records a 5-minute video demo explaining the key points and acceptance criteria, then shares it with clear written questions for asynchronous feedback.
chinese: 纽约的市场协调员Sarah需要伦敦和东京的团队成员对一项营销活动提案提供反馈，但这些成员处于不同的时区。
伦敦团队与另一个项目截止日期存在优先级冲突，而东京团队因语言障碍需要更多时间进行审阅。
Sarah录制了一段5分钟的视频演示，解释关键点和验收标准，然后分享给团队成员，并附上明确的书面问题以获取异步反馈。

firstAttempt.prompt: 欧洲和亚洲同事无法参加同一场设计评审。请用英文说明你已把设计演示和问题清单放进共享文档，并邀请他们在方便时异步留言。
firstAttempt.sample: I’ve added the design walkthrough and a list of review questions to the shared document. Please leave your comments in the thread whenever you have time in your workday.
firstAttempt.rationale: 把设计评审材料放到共享文档中，再请不同时区的同事在工作时间异步留言。

words.collocation: manage distributed teams, work with distributed teams
words.example: Effective communication strategies are essential for managing distributed teams across different continents.
words.translation: 有效的沟通策略对于管理跨不同大洲的分布式团队至关重要。
words.note: 指地理位置分散的团队成员，通常通过远程技术协作完成工作

words.collocation: work inclusively, design inclusively, communicate inclusively
words.example: When designing our new workflow, we made sure to consider all team members' needs and work inclusively.
words.translation: 设计新工作流程时，我们确保考虑所有团队成员的需求并包容性地工作。
words.note: 强调在决策和协作过程中考虑并纳入不同背景、观点和能力的团队成员

words.collocation: define acceptance criteria, meet acceptance criteria
words.example: Before approving the feature, the product manager will verify that it meets all the predefined acceptance criteria.
words.translation: 在批准该功能前，产品经理将验证它是否满足所有预定义的验收标准。
words.note: 指产品或功能必须满足的具体条件和要求，用于确定是否可以被接受或完成

words.collocation: use asynchronous agendas, prepare asynchronous agendas
words.example: Our team has adopted asynchronous agendas to accommodate members in different time zones without requiring real-time participation.
words.translation: 我们的团队采用了异步议程，以适应不同时区的成员，无需要求实时参与。
words.note: 指为异步会议设计的议程，允许参与者在不同时间查看和贡献

words.example: To ensure balanced participation, we rotate facilitators among team members from different regions.
words.translation: 为确保平衡参与，我们在不同地区的团队成员之间轮换主持人。
words.note: 指引导会议或讨论过程的人，帮助团队有效沟通和达成共识

words.collocation: validation process, validation steps, validation criteria
words.example: The quality assurance team created a detailed validation process to ensure the new feature meets all requirements.
words.translation: 质量保证团队创建了一个详细的验证流程，以确保新功能满足所有要求。
words.note: 指通过系统化的检查和测试来确认某事物是否符合预期标准或要求

structure.original: Purpose: Practical guidance for distributed teams to collaborate effectively and inclusively across time zones.
analysis: “Purpose:” 是小标题；后面的内容是名词短语，不是完整句子。
中心名词短语是“Practical guidance”（实用指南）。
“for distributed teams”说明指南面向谁；“to collaborate effectively and inclusively”说明指南要帮助团队做什么；“across time zones”修饰 collaborate，说明跨时区这一场景。
structure.transfer: A short demo, written summary, and shared issue let teammates review the proposal when they are available.

rewrite.bad: Could we schedule a live meeting? Everyone should be online at the same time before we can review the work.
rewrite.good: I’ve added the design walkthrough and a list of review questions to the shared document. Please leave your comments in the thread whenever you have time in your workday.
rewrite.translation: 我已把设计演示和评审问题清单放进共享文档。请在各自工作时间里到讨论串留言。
rewrite.pattern: I’ve added [the design walkthrough] and [review questions] to [the shared document]. Please leave [comments] during [your workday].
